system.description:
The Exalt has crystalline amulets inserted into major nerve clusters, designed to regulate and mute pain signals as necessary, though he retains full tactical awareness of his injuries. This Charm reduces all wound penalties by (Stamina ÷ 2, rounded up).

Submodules: Emergency Damage Compensators (Essence 4): If the wound penalty reduction afforded by the Charm exceeds the Exalt's actual wound penalty, the wound penalty is not ignored, but reversed, becoming bonus dice to all non-reflexive physical actions and Virtue rolls (including actions enhanced by Virtue channels). This bonus counts against Charm dice limits. Pain Determinism (Stamina 6, Essence 5): This submodule allows the Exalt to deliberately regulate his Pain Suppression Nodes, canceling all wound penalties and ensuring automatic reversal if he has Emergency Damage Compensators installed. The Champion hurts only if he wishes it.
